symptoms.symptom: Oven door is locked and will not open, even after cooling

causes.label: The door lock is engaged
remedies: Turn the oven off at the circuit breaker and wait five minutes.
Turn breaker back on. a The oven should reset itself and will be operable.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 37: "The door lock is engaged"

causes.label: There is no gas supply to the appliance.
remedies: Check the gas supply at all shut-off valve locations including at the building
supply line and interior gas inlet.
Check that the small, red toggle switch on the appliance pressure regulator is in
the open position.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 37: "There is no gas supply to the appliance."

causes.label: There is no power supply to the appliance
remedies: Check circuit breaker or fuse box to your house.
Make sure there is proper electrical power to the appliance. There is no cooking temperature set
Set a heating mode temperature.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 37: "There is no power supply to the appliance"

causes.label: The oven temperature needs to be recalibrated Note: The oven is carefully calibrated to provide accurate results.
remedies: If food is consistently too brown or too light the temperature can be offset.
→ "Oven temperature offset", Page 25
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 37: "The oven temperature needs to be recalibrated Note: The oven is carefully calibrated to provide accurate results."

symptoms.symptom: Oven light is not working properly

causes.label: The oven light bulb is loose or burnt out
remedies: Replace or reinsert the light bulb.
→ "Replacing an oven light bulb", Page 34 Tip: Touching the bulb with fingers may cause the bulb to burn out.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 37: "The oven light bulb is loose or burnt out"

symptoms.symptom: Oven light does not turn off

causes.label: The oven door does not close properly
remedies: Check the appliance door for obstructions.
Check to see if the hinge is bent. The oven light is turned on ▶ Press the oven light button to turn the oven light off.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 37: "The oven door does not close properly"

symptoms.symptom: Cannot remove lens cover on light

causes.label: There is soil build-up around the lens cover
remedies: Let the oven cavity cool off.
Wipe the lens cover area with a clean, dry towel, then try to remove the lens
cover.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 37: "There is soil build-up around the lens cover"

causes.label: The oven is too hot to start self clean
remedies: Allow the oven to cool before running self clean.
Always wipe out loose soils or heavy spillovers before running self clean.
If the oven is heavily soiled, set the maximum self clean time.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 38: "The oven is too hot to start self clean"

symptoms.symptom: Clock and timer are not working properly

causes.label: There is no power supply to the appliance
remedies: Check circuit breaker or fuse box to your house.
Make sure there is proper electrical power to the appliance.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 38: "There is no power supply to the appliance"

symptoms.symptom: "E" and a number appears in display and control beeps

causes.label: An electronics fault has occured
remedies: Press any button or turn any knob to stop the beeping.
Reset the oven if necessary.
Call an authorized service provider.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 38: "An electronics fault has occured"

symptoms.symptom: With a new oven there is a strong odor when oven is turned on Control does not react when a key is touched

causes.label: This is normal with a new oven and will disappear after a few uses
remedies: Operate the self clean mode to burn-off the smell more quickly.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 38: "This is normal with a new oven and will disappear after a few uses"

causes.label: The control is wet or soiled
remedies: Clean the control panel an wipe it dry.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 38: "The control is wet or soiled"

causes.label: The touch keys are not pressed correctly
remedies: Press the center of the button.
Use the flat part of your finger.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 38: "The touch keys are not pressed correctly"

symptoms.symptom: Warm air or steam escapes from oven vent

causes.label: It is normal to see or feel steam or warm air escaping from the oven vent
remedies: CAUTION

symptoms.symptom: The burner flame is not uniform.

causes.label: The burner parts are not positioned correctly.
remedies: Position the burner parts correctly.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 39: "The burner parts are not positioned correctly."

causes.label: The grooves on the burner are dirty.
remedies: Clean the grooves on the burner.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 39: "The grooves on the burner are dirty."

symptoms.symptom: The gas flow is not normal or there is no gas.

causes.label: The gas cylinder is empty.
remedies: Replace the gas cylinder.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 39: "The gas cylinder is empty."

symptoms.symptom: There is a smell of gas in the kitchen.

causes.label: A gas valve has been left on.
remedies: Turn off the gas taps.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 39: "A gas valve has been left on."

causes.label: Incorrect coupling of gas cylinder.
remedies: Check the proper connection to the gas cylinder.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 39: "Incorrect coupling of gas cylinder."

causes.label: The gas pipe to the appliance is leaking.
remedies: Shut off the gas supply at the main gas valve.
Ventilate the premises.
Immediately notify an authorized installation technician to check and certify the
installation.
Do not use the appliance until you can be sure there are no gas leaks in the gas
supply line or the appliance.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 39: "The gas pipe to the appliance is leaking."

symptoms.symptom: The burner switches off immediately after releasing the control knob.

causes.label: The control knob has not been pressed down long enough.
remedies: Keep the control knob pressed in for a few seconds after ignition.
Push the control knob in firmly. The grooves on the burner are dirty. ▶ Clean the grooves on the burner.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 39: "The control knob has not been pressed down long enough."
